hotels.title: Hamptons-Style Port Stephens Waterfront Escape with Daily Sparkling Wine Breakfast & Nightly Drinks
hotels.description: Discover bayfront beauty in abundance when you stay at this idyllic Hamptons-style resort with direct access to the beach. Anchorage Hotel & Spa is a serene seaside retreat overlooking one of the world’s most stunning marinas. This waterfront haven features elegant rooms and mezzanine suites designed to showcase the beauty of the coastline. Unwind in coastal-inspired interiors with uninterrupted marina views in a sanctuary renowned as one of the finest havens for dolphin and whale watching. At its heart is The Galley Kitchen and Moby's Bar, offering a seasonal menu with the finest local produce, alongside two swimming pools - including an adults-only infinity pool - and the indulgent Spa Lucca for pure relaxation. Whether relaxing on your balcony, enjoying the poolside oasis or curling up by the fire in the guest lounge, Anchorage Hotel & Spa invites you to unwind and recharge in effortless elegance.

hotels.title: Hamptons-Style Waterfront Luxury in Serene Port Stephens
hotels.description: Experience Hamptons-style luxury at its finest at The Anchorage Port Stephens Hotel & Spa, a breezy seaside haven overlooking one of the world’s most beautiful ports. Featuring spacious waterfront guestrooms and mezzanine-style suites in an idyllic location, the resort is home to The Galley Kitchen restaurant, serving a seasonal menu of local produce, two swimming pools, including an adults-only infinity pool, and a decadent day spa - Spa Lucca.

hotels.vendor_name: Oaks Port Stephens Pacific Blue Resort
hotels.title: Port Stephens Oaks Resort Stay with Serene Lagoon Pool
hotels.description: Escape to the most idyllic spot on New South Wales' coastline with a relaxing stay at Oaks Port Stephens Pacific Blue Resort - a convenient retreat with resort-style facilities, including an impressive lagoon pool, onsite restaurant, tennis courts, Japanese-style steam room and gym. Enjoy a prime position to experience the region's tranquil bay, stunning natural surroundings, beautiful beaches and laidback coastal lifestyle. Located a 2.5-hour drive from Sydney and less than an hour from Newcastle, Port Stephens is blessed with everything you need for a relaxing escape with family and friends. Renowned for its spectacular natural scenery, white sand beaches, dramatic sand dunes plunging into clear aquamarine waters, as well as restaurants and boutiques, this laid-back town promises something for everyone.
